_README: You write the anchors. Each one asserts a causal claim -- this old state,
plus this event, gives this new state -- and that claim is YOURS, not an
LLM's. The generator only puts it into words.
REQUIREMENTS PER ATTRIBUTE
states: at least THREE, so counterfactual and conflict conditions can be
built. Each needs a single-token `label` (verified against the
tokenizer at build time) -- `transit`, not `public_transit`.
Multi-token labels make logit-lens trajectories at the decision
token unreadable.
events: at least TWO from the same old state, leading to DIFFERENT new
states. Without this you cannot tell computing f(S,E) apart from
memorising E -> new_state.
EVENT WRITING RULES
- never name any state label, in any form
- describe what happened, never what the person now wants
- one causal step: a reader should not need two inferences
- `type` is from the taxonomy below; used for per-type analysis
TAXONOMY (from the colleague's note, kept as-is)
constraint   the old option becomes harmful or impossible
resource     what the old option required is gone
environment   surroundings changed
goal          a new goal conflicts with the old option
experience    a bad experience with the old option
The three filled examples below are a FORMAT DEMONSTRATION. Replace them.
If you keep any, treat them as mine and not independently authored.

events.note: insurance, repairs and parking outrun the budget

events.effect: cycling becomes physically impossible and distance grows
events.note: broken collarbone plus a job forty miles away

events.effect: everything needed is now within a short ride
events.note: moved into the town centre; distances collapse

events.effect: the facility the old option required disappears
events.note: moved to a village with no pool, plenty of hillside
rotator cuff injury; no overhead motion

events.effect: the time available to read a reply collapses
events.note: reads replies between dispatch calls, seconds at a time

events.effect: every step must now be documented and defensible
events.note: moved into a regulated role where reasoning is auditable

events.effect: replies must be scannable and passed to someone else
events.note: replies get pasted into a shift handover others read
